description:
Order through Kaupia. customer = {name, email, address1, address2?, city, state, zip, phone?} (US only).
    The user pays Kaupia the delivered price at pay_url (Stripe); the participating merchant fulfills directly for the
    user. Confirm item and address and pass the buyer-approved exact quote total as approved_total.
    A changed or missing total creates no order. Problems are reviewed through order help; refunds are not automatic.
name: place_order
